name: page-feature-groups
goal: Group related list, detail and history pages by feature and teach that structure in generated agent guidance while preserving routes and unit identities

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Planned feature specification defines nine route-feature groups, stable URLs/IDs, emitted agent guidance and desktop/tablet/mobile acceptance.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing module-groups and category browser scenarios used only synthetic Orders categories. Extended the shared fixture with actual registered page manifests and committed project taxonomy; generated-project and guide tests now require feature-folder guidance.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint adc7354abf371012a86a84f33325b89570b4706ec0025e59e6c7efbe3110167f at e6c96d32: emitted guidance, real-manifest catalog groups and all three browser viewports fail the unchanged acceptance assertions; original images and 196 contextual observations retained.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added nine specific route-folder taxonomy aliases and one shared feature-folder rule consumed by guides and generated instructions; synchronized repository agent guidance without changing route sources, unit IDs or shared cards.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 66ef7836f3d4f219197877c87b532fa61bf1e6d76a3474c8a93c93f7f756b719 passes the same frozen unit, generated-guidance and three-viewport browser command at 242d0cec; references red 69c2faca, preserves 90 images and 200 observations.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
